_comment: #378. When each provider's free window resets or ends, so a $0 run does not silently become a paid one. `resets` is a recurring boundary (monthly credit); `ends` is a one-off promo with no renewal. Omit both when the terms are genuinely open-ended - the calendar reports that as unknown rather than treating it as safe. Dates are ISO and hand-maintained: this is a reminder, not an API reading.
